content.ascii:
[P1] Content revisions, alternatives, and review
|
|-- Immutable DiagramRevision
|   |-- Diagram: ASCII, structure, source context and evidence
|   `-- nodeRefs preserve proven logical node identity across revisions
|
|-- Content revision flow
|   |-- create / revise / derive -> validated immutable revision
|   |-- generation or supplied edit -> candidate -> retained revision
|   `-- controller publishes revision; canvas history checkpoints its binding
|
|-- Presentation alternatives: choices per placement
|   |-- pin revision and base; target whole diagram or subtree nodeRef
|   |-- select atomic parts; compose displayed rows with provenance
|   |-- side panel compares a pinned part in regular or diff view
|   `-- selection changes display, leaving bound content unchanged
|
`-- Review: decisions about bound content
    |-- retained candidate + base/head revisions + accept/reject decisions
    |-- save decisions without changing the binding
    |-- explicit apply checks dependencies and conflicts, then binds result
    `-- alternative may reference a review; presentation is independent

Canvas checkpoints retain choices, panels, and referenced revisions.
Presentation annotations and folding remain separate from content.
